title: Communication Enables Cooperation in LLM Agents: A Comparison with Curriculum-Based Approaches
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates LLM agents on their ability to cooperate in social dilemmas (such as the Prisoner's Dilemma and Public Goods Game). These scenarios are used to measure pro-social behavior and strategic reasoning regarding collective versus individual welfare, which are core topics in moral and ethical decision-making for AI alignment.
